profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer at Vermeer
profile.summary:
I am an ambitious, young, passionate engineer who loves problem solving and learning new things. 

GitHub: https://github.com/jl35808

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: C++ Development in QT with QML for Embedded UI. Leader of Qt Working Group which focuses on continuous improvement of company use of Qt.

positions.title: Software Firmware Engineer
positions.locationName: Arden Hills, Minnesota, United States · On-site
positions.description: Embedded Software Development in Embedded C/C++ on STM32 Microcontrollers for PacBio project MiniLightPen. High level design in plantUML. Explored possible use cases for Embedded Python. Came up with power point presentation to demonstrate use cases for AI tools such as GPT-4 and Microsoft Copilot; used by senior management as a reference for integrating such products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Created new proprietary internal tools in Advanced Tools Development group in Cardiac Rhythm management team. Python, C++ and C# software development on the Denali Firmware Verification system for cardiac rhythm management devices. Made significant bug fixes and improvements to the cardiac simulator along with acceptance testing for the cardiac simulator.

positions.title: Software Test Automation Engineer
positions.description: Performing Software, Hardware and Firmware Testing on the Ensite Cardiac Ablation System. Testing included Hardware Setup, Cardiac Mapping, GUI and Patient Data Integrity. Documented issues using JIRA and PTC. Assisting in training documentation development for future contractors.

positions.title: Relocation
positions.description: Enjoyed a well deserved summer break after getting my computer science degree while working full time. Moved back to Minneapolis-St. Paul Metropolitan area where I am originally from to pursue opportunities.

positions.title: C++ Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Grand Forks, North Dakota, United States
positions.description: C++ programming for payroll processing systems. Designed, debugged, tested and updated legacy software. Porting data from xml to SQLite. Designed features to automate software systems. Ensure smooth rollout of product releases and address issues found via QA System Test process.

positions.title: Hardware Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: Grand Forks, North Dakota, United States
positions.description: Interfaced with DJI M200 drones in Linux Ubuntu OS through onboard computing in NVIDIA TX2 boards using arm computer architecture. Designed flight routines using Robot Operating Systems in C++, and DJI-SDK in C++.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Replaced Bioprocess monitoring system using parallel port and Visual Basic with RS- 485 serial port and python prototype software. Made computer engineering design decisions to ensure efficient system. Provided documentation and training to technical support. Assisted in rewriting prototype to C#.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: Grand Forks, North Dakota, United States
positions.description: Assisted in managing the electric grid in northeastern North Dakota. Processed work orders, and updating GIS data. Remodeled northeastern electric grid map to be precise for electrical linemen using GPS to locate overhead and underground infrastructure.

honors.title: Most Dedicated Engineer
honors.description: "For Your Passion Towards Your Engineering Field"
honors.issuer: Issued by University of North Dakota Engineering Living and Learning Community · Apr 2015
